title: PAR-49/7G.3 AC1015 paper-space chain and readDwgBlocks integration
scope: Exercise the pre-AC1018 BLOCK_RECORD first/last entity-chain walker with generated entity frames.
Compare per-record ownership identities against an AC1027 explicit-owner control.
Add bounded missing-middle and explicit-relative-link cycle controls.
Exercise readDwgBlocks dispatch with generated block/entity frames and supplied in-memory BLOCK_RECORD/layout metadata.

formatEvidence.source: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
formatEvidence.contractUsed: R13-R2000 nolinks=0 means previous/next handles are present; those handles are relative soft pointers.
formatEvidence.purpose: Construct a generated AC1015 explicit-link cycle vector using the documented wire form.

sections: Model Space and Paper Space Block Definitions
formatEvidence.contractUsed: Conventional paper-space block names include *Paper_Space, *Paper_Space0, *Paper_Space1, and subsequent numbered records.
formatEvidence.purpose: Confirm the standard suffix-name family that the generated readDwgBlocks integration exposed as unrecognized locally.

generatedCases.recordManifest: empty default paper space; Sheet A has two contiguous paper-space lines; Sheet B has one singleton line
assertions: layout name and layout handle are associated with the supplied BLOCK_RECORD handle
exact line handles and order are observed under each chain walk
firstEH == lastEH terminates the singleton before the following sentinel
a missing middle handle stops traversal and leaves the later frame unconsumed

generatedCases.recordManifest: two explicit relative-link paper-space entities link to each other before a distinct declared last-handle sentinel
assertions: nolinks=0 causes the reader to decode explicit previous/next handles
both reachable entities are published exactly once before cycle detection
the repeated first handle terminates the cycle and returns an incomplete walk
the following sentinel frame remains unconsumed in ObjectMap

generatedCases.recordManifest: same entity identities through explicit owner handles
assertions: normalized per-record entity manifest matches AC1015
each parsed entity retains its explicit BLOCK_RECORD owner
following unowned sentinel remains outside the record walk

generatedCases.recordManifest: empty default paper layout; *PAPER_SPACE0 has two lines; *PAPER_SPACE1 has one line; BLOCK/ENDBLK delimiters and a following sentinel are generated
assertions: readDwgBlocks dispatches the expected block, entity, and end callbacks
each generated line is associated with the expected paper-space block record and layout
numbered paper-space records are recognized without absorbing entities into a sibling layout
the following sentinel remains outside the block chain

implementation.testBoundary: Direct walkBlockRecordEntities() tests plus readDwgBlocks() integration with generated BLOCK/ENDBLK/entity frames and supplied in-memory DRW_Block_Record/layout metadata. readDwgTables(), BLOCK_RECORD byte decoding, LAYOUT object decoding, and full-file section integration are not exercised.
limitations: The readDwgBlocks integration supplies table/layout records; it does not validate full-file BLOCK_RECORD/LAYOUT decode or section integration.
No real producer drawing or producer interoperability qualification.
The local ODA PDF copy is absent; the official ODA-hosted v5.4.1 PDF was reviewed for §§20.4.1–20.4.2.
No native producer interoperability or producer-specific cycle policy is established.

confirmedLocalDefectsFixedInSlice: isSpaceBlockRecordName() accepted exact *PAPER_SPACE but rejected standard numbered *PAPER_SPACE0, *PAPER_SPACE1, and subsequent numeric suffix records; generated readDwgBlocks integration reproduced the omission and the classifier now accepts the base name or a nonempty all-decimal suffix.
assessment.planImpact: Extends existing PAR-49/7G.3 with generated direct-walker and readDwgBlocks dispatch coverage, including legacy chain membership, missing handles, explicit relative-link cycle termination, numbered paper-space names, exact callbacks/ownership, and an AC1027 comparison. It fixes one confirmed local name-classification gap. Full readDwgTables/BLOCK_RECORD/LAYOUT decoding and producer interoperability remain open; no new finding ID/top-level subplan or broad support claim is added.

method.sourceFixturePolicy: All DWG entity frames are generated locally in memory from scratch; no persistent or downloaded DWG/DXF fixtures are added.
